subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like tool failures be suppressed even when `includeDetails` is true, including cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose detail paths?
rationale: Current tests intentionally surface detail-bearing exec warnings in those modes, so automation should not rewrite the policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Clarify and revise before merge
options.body: Confirm the intended policy, then update the branch ordering and tests so normal, mutating, cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose cases are all explicit.

options.title: Keep existing detail-warning behavior
options.body: Reject the suppress-all direction and narrow the linked issue to the cases where warning noise is actually unintended.

options.title: Accept suppress-all risk
options.body: Merge only if maintainers intentionally want all exec-like detail-bearing warnings hidden despite the current test contract.

recommendation.title: Clarify and revise before merge
recommendation.body: Confirm the intended policy, then update the branch ordering and tests so normal, mutating, cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose cases are all explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest recent history across the shared tool mutation, warning, and error-normalization surfaces affected by the policy choice.
